lastData.title: New chat
lastData.textTail:
is used more often and more generously than people expect.

Required Korean text, keep large and clean:
Headline:
토너는 생각보다 빨리 줄어듭니다

Subheadline:
세안 후 첫 단계부터 화장솜, 스킨팩, 레이어링까지
매일 쓰는 토너라면 넉넉함이 먼저입니다

Visual structure:
- Top: clean headline area with soft aqua water glow.
- Middle: 3 or 4 usage moments shown as premium rounded cards or lifestyle vignettes:
  1) 세안 후 첫 단계
  2) 화장솜에도 넉넉하게
  3) 건조한 날 레이어링
  4) 스킨팩으로 집중 수분
- Bottom: transition band leading to next cut, with concise copy:
그래서 V1은 500ml 대용량에 집중했습니다

Visual content:
- Show realistic toner usage cues: cotton pads soaked with clear watery toner, fresh clean face after washing, palms pressing watery toner into skin, sheet/cotton pack mood.
- Toner should look watery and transparent, not creamy lotion.
- If showing the bottle, make it moderate size only; this is not a hero bottle cut.

Hard constraints:
- No embedded cut numbers, no DETAIL CUT, no POINT 02, no STEP numbers, no big numeric badges.
- No medical/therapeutic claims.
- Do NOT use: 피부 깊은 곳까지, 속부터 충전, 피부 장벽 강화, 진정 효과, 민감 피부도 안심, 안전한 성분만, 트러블 완화, 치료, 재생, 회복.
- Avoid tiny Korean paragraphs. Use only the required large Korean text plus short card labels.
- Korean text must be clean, natural, and not garbled.
- Do not write 제품명 incorrectly. If product name appears, it must be 히알루론산 토너 or HYALURONIC ACID TONER 500ml.
- No fake certificates, fake test documents, fake EWG logos.

Desired feeling:
Soft, helpful, premium, practical. The buyer should immediately think: “맞아, 토너는 많이 쓰니까 500ml가 좋겠다.”
